title: Annoying office habits
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which office habit annoys you most: noise, lateness, messy spaces, interruptions, or something else?
When should you speak directly to a colleague about an annoying habit?
Are open-plan offices partly responsible for irritating workplace behaviour?
Should companies create rules for small behaviours such as phone calls, food smells, or desk cleanliness?
What habit might you have that could annoy other people without you noticing?
